expected_effect: Clarifying the three existing output fields may produce an actionable conditional investigation strategy and genuine counterevidence instead of a task-specific repair guess.
baseline: The captured model response is structurally proposed but uses a category label for action, repeats task-specific code repair identifiers and supplies supporting observations as counterevidence. It is not selected for cross-task trial.
changed_factor: Existing StrategyExperience.propose_from_episode system text and three schema-field descriptions only. The controller also accepts an explicit intent path; that path and postcheck normalization are not model inputs.
verification: Focused common-owner and normal-terminal controlled checks, then exactly one new model extraction with the same public selections/model/profile. Review action concreteness, transfer scope and falsifying counterconditions against the explicit contract. This does not establish correctness, adoption or migration benefit.
outer_assistance: Outer Codex changes generic field definitions after reviewing the observed malformed strategy. No reference strategy, task-specific repair or hidden result is supplied; model output will not be rewritten by the outer developer.
execution_condition: New absolute output/store and parent-owned600-second process window. Old attempts stay terminal. A result may remain unsuitable and end this experiment without another retry.
why: 为什么要有它：已有真实输出暴露了字段含义没有被正确采用，应验证一个明确请求改动，而不是反复同配置抽样、替模型改写经验或把结构合法当成可迁移收益。
